name: Tabnine
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Tabnine, provide local repository completions and chat through a selected model endpoint. The hard boundary is enterprise deployment, private models, ide coverage, governance, and support, plus frontier models, context infrastructure, and execution safety.
